show.title: Haseeno Ka Deewana
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/M7pH4X
show.description: Haseeno Ka Deewana is a quirky romantic drama with a magical twist. Kabir, a struggling vlogger desperate to prove himself, stumbles upon a mysterious phone with an “Attract Beauty Mode” that suddenly pulls him into the lives of powerful, complicated women. Between love, rivalry, betrayal, and a dangerous corporate game, Kabir must decide if this strange gift is his ticket to success—or the trap that could ruin everything.
